snippet.title: Suncraft | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Suncraft is a cozy village crafting adventure set in a small pixel world that is slowly waking up again. Every tool you craft, seed you plant, and favor you do for a neighbor helps the land feel a little more alive.

🌱 Wishlist Suncraft on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078110/Suncraft

You arrive as the newest villager in a place that has gone quiet, with forests full of old stories, broken bridges, and strange machines waiting to be fixed. Your days are spent gathering, rebuilding, and getting to know the people who still call this place home.

Play at your own pace, with no timers and no pressure. Settle into a calm loop of gathering, crafting, exploring new zones, and slowly watching the village change around you.

In Suncraft you will:
• Explore peaceful forests, lava fields, snowy peaks, and forgotten ruins for new resources
• Turn raw materials into tools, parts, and buildings that bring the village back to life
• Upgrade your abilities so everyday tasks feel smoother and more satisfying
• Help villagers repair bridges, reopen old spaces, and solve gentle little puzzles
• Meet characters like Eric, Penny, Hank, Kael, and Niko, each with their own hopes and problems
• Watch the world quietly transform as you rebuild it one small task at a time

Stay in touch:
Website: https://spicytuna.games
Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078110/Suncraft
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/qCTCGFypzc
